campaign.title: W=Y^(7/16) literal local transverse lift-variation gate

resource_policy.literature_policy: No external theorem is needed for the coefficient gate. A source may be consulted only if it supplies an exact variation inequality whose hypotheses are checked against every literal coefficient package.

frozen_target.question: For every literal M1/M2 complete-lift coefficient on one moving reciprocal window at W=Y^(7/16), is its local V^2 norm O_epsilon(J_B^(1/2)L^(-1)Y^epsilon), or does an exact coefficient package force a larger variation and stop the selected route?
frozen_target.reference_formula: On b' asymptotic B, write G=D/B, Q_B=min(B,BD/(WL)), J_B=1+DQ_B/B^2, b'=rho v, and U_(i,rho)(v)=sum_(g in I_(i,rho)(v))^* chi_4(g) omega_i(g,a',rho v). Prove ||U_(i,rho)||_(V^2(I)) <<_epsilon J_B^(1/2)L^(-1)Y^epsilon uniformly, including endpoint values, or isolate the first literal counterterm.
quantities: Q_B=BD/(WL)=Y^(log_Y B-5/48) on the critical block
The desired exponent theta=1/2 is useful only because theta<2/3; full-shell G^(1/2) variation is insufficient
A proof of this coefficient norm alone does not prove the subsequent oscillatory inequality or any exponent improvement

completion_criteria: Reconstruct the exact literal U_(i,rho)(v) for M1 and M2 from accepted artifacts, including every taper, character, lift, sign, profile, floor, hard sample, star, support birth and exit, and divisor progression.
Separate pure moving-endpoint births from continuous v-dependence of tapers and profiles, fixed endpoint values, Mobius/progression weights, and cross-shell ownership.
Prove the J_B^(1/2)/L V^2 bound for every package, prove it on a strict complete subset and isolate the exact residual, or construct a literal package forcing a larger power.
Audit both V^2 endpoint terms; bounded increments alone are not sufficient if U(v_-) or U(v_+) has full lift capacity.
Keep chi_4(g) cancellation inside each complete lift sum before any modulus and test arbitrary phase-conjugating lift coefficients as a false control.
Verify that floors, stars, strict and weak faces, support births, and moving symbols change at the claimed J_B rate on the actual Q_B window.
Check the effective J_B exponent: theta<2/3 passes the conditional capacity gate, theta>=2/3 stops it.
If the coefficient gate passes, state the exact remaining V^2-weighted curvature theorem without claiming it; if it fails, state the smallest rigorous obstruction and stop the graded route.
State conservatively that no M9 parent, global exponent, or quarter theorem changes in this round without the subsequent analytic inequality.

tasks.target: Determine exactly what local birth-count and character hypotheses can imply about the V^2 norm, and either prove the displayed abstract bound or give the sharpest countermodel and necessary missing hypothesis without using historical reports.
excluded_context: all Round-95 through Round-128 nonblind artifacts
required_output: A proof of the abstract local V^2 bound under explicit hypotheses, or a sharp countermodel and minimal repaired hypotheses.
Separate conclusions for endpoint births, continuous weights, and V^2 endpoint values.

tasks.target: Reconstruct the exact M1/M2 complete-lift coefficient on a moving B-shell window and prove the local J_B^(1/2)/L V^2 bound package by package, or isolate the first literal residual or counterterm.
required_output: An exact literal coefficient dictionary before any variation estimate.
A packagewise V^2 proof, strict partial theorem plus exact residual, or literal no-go.
The first doubtful step and a precise state recommendation without editing shared state.

tasks.target: Hostilely audit whether J_B counts every literal source of variation and whether endpoint values, continuous weights, Mobius progressions, hard faces, and cross-shell terms force a larger capacity; certify a proof only after all seams close.
required_output: A seam matrix covering every literal variation source and both V^2 endpoints.
A reproducible counterexample if the stated bound fails, or an independent derivation if it passes.
A conservative promotion, revision, rejection, or no-change recommendation.

review_seams.requirement: Every actual M1/M2 lift coefficient and owner is explicitly defined before a norm is taken.
The J_B birth count is proved on the same Q_B reciprocal window used by the curvature estimate, not on a different or completed shell.
Endpoint values, discrete births, continuous v-dependence, stars, floors, hard faces, and support entries/exits are all charged exactly once.
The common lift character remains inside complete lift sums until its partial-sum cancellation is used.
The effective local exponent is below two thirds; no full-lift or reciprocal-window square-root loss is hidden.
A coefficient-norm result is not promoted to the oscillatory inequality, a global exponent, M9, or the quarter theorem.
